title: PlaneMem legacy memory handoff creation and claim
description: Source-only nominal built-in MemoryServiceAdapter results and actual open HTTP input. These references are distinct from durable session handoff/checkpoint/resume records. No generated client, validator or runtime verification.
$comment: Static shapes cannot bind source id to result.page_ref, identify the configured provider or authenticate a supplied reference. Custom external providers are delegated to without complete result validation. The legacy Gateway route reads raw context headers, not verified bearer claims.

nonempty.description: Nonempty string only, no trimming, nonblank/length/ULID/URI restriction at the legacy HTTP handler.

idempotency_key.description: Ignored business field; only a truthy Idempotency-Key header enables process response caching.

expected_version.description: Not a business CAS. If a version header is present, the global pre-dispatch guard requires exact equality of a supplied body value to the parsed numeric header version.

createBody.description: Unknown fields retained in process fingerprint but otherwise ignored. Scope comes from raw required headers, not body. No original identity or verified-client gate at this route; expected actor/client headers and top-level body identity equality checks belong to other routes.

client_id.description: Selected only if claim_client_id is absent, and then must be a nonempty string. Ignored, including its type, when claim_client_id is supplied. Neither field is compared to the header client.

idempotency_key.description: Ignored business field. Does not enable caching or propagate a stable key to the provider.

expected_version.description: No handoff version check. Global body/header version equality still applies if both supplied.

claimBody.description: Selected client = claim_client_id, otherwise body client_id, otherwise raw x-client-id. Adapter claim receives no tenant/workspace/project/current actor or request trace. Built-in remote provider ignores the selected client entirely; local fallback does not compare an existing claimant.

createResult.description: Complete built-in nominal result. Original page_ref text preserved; fresh inner trace equals request trace. No scope, actor, claimant, revision, hash, expiry, durable receipt or session/checkpoint ID. Custom external providers are not parsed into this schema by Gateway.

localCreateResult.description: Fallback for providers lacking either external handoff method: calls read_page with requested scope, then creates ULID and stores page_ref/optional claimant only in this adapter instance. No persistent ledger or cross-instance recovery.

remoteCreateResult.description: Built-in MCP provider constructs encoded workspace/project/handoff_id and encodeURIComponent(original page_ref). External handoff_id must only be a nonempty string, not ULID. Create page_ref prefix must equal ai-memory://encoded workspace/encoded project/; path before first ? decoded, remaining query ignored, tenant not encoded. Shape alone does not prove relation or scope.

claimResult.description: Local already_claimed means some truthy claimant was saved; no comparison to requesting client or returned owner. Remote only exact upstream status='claimed' maps to claimed, every other status/missing field on a non-null decoded result maps to already_claimed. Remote page_ref is decoded from the caller's reference, not checked against returned provider data. No origin ownership or current page-readability proof.

sources.description: One constructed source whose id equals result.page_ref verbatim. Not a source-currentness, authorization or content-hash check.

createEnvelope.description: Fresh outer/inner request trace; no ETag/revision/receipt. Matching process cache returns original whole envelope, including original trace, even with a different current trace. Cache hit skips provider/page check after current policy/audit.

claimEnvelope.description: Fresh current outer trace, no trace inside result/no ETag. Cache hit can replay original claimed status and trace without re-running claim; a new uncached local claim would instead observe already_claimed.
